system.description:
Said to have been born from the union of man and fiend, or from a cursed bloodline, Fiendkin often find themselves outcasts in society. Yet, they embody determination in the face of adversity. Their ancestors didn't emerge from the depths of the Everflame to succumb to minor setbacks!

Flameborn

1 of your neutral saves is advantaged instead. [M]

You know Infernal if your INT is not negative. [M]

Fiendkin Curses: Curse of Impalement — Thy skin is broken, eternally pained.

Barbed Skin

Reaction (when attacked): Until the start of your next turn, you deal 1d4 piercing damage to enemies when they attack you in melee. Does not miss or crit. [M]

Nim+ Volume I ancestry variant (LewisH, Santuric). Variants replace the base ancestry: pick this instead of the standard version. Note: variants make your hero stronger than normal.
